source.name: Agent Approval Protocol
source.source_stability: versioned web specification; repository revision could not be resolved through the current GitHub connector, so this mapping does not claim immutable source pinning

observed_semantics.evidence_claim: The provider stores one approval request with an immutable terminal decision.
The v1 OpenAPI describes the idempotency key as identifying one execution attempt; same-key same-input retries return the existing request.
Submitted approval-request fields are immutable, but an independent runtime still needs to prove the action about to execute matches them.
The adapter must start an approved call before expires_at.
AAP Approval states that the adapter enforces permission and the harness or adapter tracks whether execution happened.

important_boundary: The provider records permission to execute; it does not establish authoritative execution finality. This mapping therefore stops at decision→execution binding and does not claim external-effect confirmation.

real_adapter_pressure.observed_limit: The Pi adapter documentation warns that extensions which replace tool inputs after approval can change what actually runs.
real_adapter_pressure.implication: An approval outcome alone is not sufficient evidence that the executed arguments still match the reviewed arguments.
real_adapter_pressure.expected_conformance_behavior: post-approval argument mutation must produce mismatch/fail rather than inheriting the prior approval
